Half Yours.latestNote: Reigning Melbourne Cup winner and 2025 Caulfield Cup-Melbourne Cup double winner. Resumed in the 2026 Makybe Diva Stakes campaign at Flemington.
Half Yours.cupRelevance: Defending champion; proven 3200m and elite handicap profile.

Aeliana.latestNote: Dual Group 1 winner in the Ranvet Stakes and Tancred Stakes last autumn. Cox Plate and Melbourne Cup have been identified as preferred spring targets.
Aeliana.cupRelevance: Top-class mare with proven 2400m Group 1 form and a live Melbourne Cup profile.

Birdman.latestNote: Improved sharply in 2026 for Chris Waller, including strong Flemington form and major middle-distance performances.
Birdman.cupRelevance: Progressive imported stayer with improving Australian profile.

Light Infantry Man.latestNote: Dual Australian Cup winner with an excellent Flemington record; being prepared from Ciaron Maher's Cranbourne base.
Light Infantry Man.cupRelevance: Elite Flemington performer, though 3200m suitability remains a key Cup question.

Ohope Wins.latestNote: ATC Oaks winner from the Chris Waller stable and part of his Flemington spring team.
Ohope Wins.cupRelevance: Group 1 staying mare with upside and a profile suited to longer spring targets.

Treasurethe Moment.latestNote: Four-time Group 1 winner with an exceptional staying-to-middle-distance profile; current VRC stable listing places Matt Laurie at Mornington.
Treasurethe Moment.cupRelevance: Elite mare with proven 2400m-2500m credentials; stamina at 3200m and likely handicap are the key Cup questions.

She’s A Hustler.latestNote: Entered for the Caulfield Cup, Cox Plate and Melbourne Cup and resumed into the Makybe Diva Stakes from Grahame Begg's Cranbourne operation.
She’s A Hustler.cupRelevance: Progressive mare with a strong strike rate; still needs to prove elite staying class and 3200m suitability.
She’s A Hustler.source: VRC 11 Sep 2026 / Makybe Diva Stakes contenders
